purpose: private authored activity pilot; not learner-facing

activities.cueEnglish: Find whether this roof is flat or sloped.
activities.modelFrench: Ce toit est en pente, pas plat.
activities.modelEnglish: This roof is sloped, not flat.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name the roof system in French.
Listen and identify the word for skylight.
Type 'Is the roof flat or sloped?' in French.
activities.modelFrench: Le toit est-il plat ou en pente ?
activities.modelEnglish: Is the roof flat or sloped?

activities.cueEnglish: Ask the crew what material covers this roof.
activities.modelFrench: Le chef d’équipe demande : « Quel matériau couvre ce toit ? »
activities.modelEnglish: The foreman asks: What material does this roof have?

activities.cueEnglish: Write where the skylight is located.
activities.modelFrench: Il y a aussi une fenêtre de toit à l’arrière.
activities.modelEnglish: There is also a skylight at the back.

activities.cueEnglish: Find what the roof deck is made of.
activities.modelFrench: En bas se trouve le support de couverture, en contreplaqué.
activities.modelEnglish: At the bottom is the roof deck, which is plywood.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name the underlayment in French.
Listen and identify the term for drip edge.
Type 'Roll out the underlayment.' in French.
Ask where the drip edge goes.
activities.modelFrench: Le chef d’équipe demande : « Où doit-on poser le larmier ? »
activities.modelEnglish: The foreman asks: Where does the drip edge go?

activities.cueEnglish: Write which layer goes on top of the deck.
activities.modelFrench: La sous-couche se pose par-dessus, par exemple du feutre bitumé.
activities.modelEnglish: The underlayment goes on top, for example felt paper.

activities.cueEnglish: Find where the step flashing is placed in this scene.
activities.modelFrench: Ici, un solin à gradins est posé près du mur.
activities.modelEnglish: Here there is step flashing next to the wall.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name the roof valley in French.
Listen and identify the word for leak.
Type 'Show me where the flashing goes.' in French.
activities.modelFrench: Montrez-moi où doit aller le solin.
activities.modelEnglish: Show me where the flashing goes.

activities.cueEnglish: Ask where the valleys are on this roof.
activities.modelFrench: Le chef d’équipe demande : « Où se trouvent les noues sur ce toit ? »
activities.modelEnglish: The foreman asks: Where are the valleys on this roof?

activities.cueEnglish: Write what the flashing helps prevent.
activities.modelFrench: Le solin aide à empêcher l’eau de pénétrer.
activities.modelEnglish: Flashing helps keep the water out.
